description: Single-game update direction for equal players
expected_behaviour: Winner rating should increase, loser rating should decrease, and RD should not increase
Weaker player should gain rating points and stronger player should lose points
New rating should be around 1464 and new RD around 151, tolerance +/-2
notes: Uses initial rating=1500, RD=200, opponents 1400/RD30 win, 1550/RD100 loss, 1700/RD300 loss.

expected_behaviour: DEFAULT_RD, MIN_RD, and MAX_RD should be defined
RD should decrease or at least not increase after a played game
No final RD should fall below MIN_RD
No final RD should exceed MAX_RD/new-player RD
Players at MIN_RD should not be almost all players
notes: This is a diagnostic threshold, not a theoretical rule.

expected_behaviour: All saved prediction probabilities should be finite and between 0 and 1
Recomputed Glicko expected score from pre-rating/RD columns should match saved pred_a_win
Saved predictions should include both pre-update and post-update state if direct audit is required
notes: This supports direct inspection of pre-match prediction versus post-match update.

expected_behaviour: Glicko and Elo should not produce completely different lists for well-observed players
notes: Threshold is diagnostic, not a formal performance criterion.
